reason: A web theme plugin that applies a configurable frosted-glass appearance with a local wallpaper and persists its settings locally.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供可上传本地壁纸的全窗口磨砂玻璃主题，并支持调整效果及本地保存设置。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web theme that applies a configurable frosted-glass interface using a locally uploaded wallpaper and locally persisted settings.

capabilities: Applies a frosted-glass visual theme to the web interface
Accepts local JPEG, PNG, WebP, or GIF wallpaper uploads
Stores the selected image in IndexedDB and settings in localStorage
Provides controls to enable, disable, save, replace, and delete the theme
